# islahwebservice.com

> AI-powered B2B lead generation agency. We build targeted prospect lists with verified decision-maker contacts for sales teams in the USA, UK, and Australia — through research, contact enrichment, and AI-powered automation.

Islah Web Service is a B2B lead generation agency that helps companies identify their ideal customers, find verified decision-makers, enrich contact data, and build CRM-ready prospect lists for outbound sales campaigns. Founded in 2016, the agency serves managed service providers (MSPs), SaaS companies, recruitment firms, and B2B professional services across the USA, UK, and Australia.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2016
- Markets: USA, UK, Australia
- Clients: MSPs, SaaS, recruitment firms, professional services, B2B sales teams
- Services: B2B lead generation, prospect list building, contact enrichment, decision-maker research
- Contact: hello@islahwebservice.com · +1 (442) 222-8258

## Services
- [B2B Lead Generation](https://www.islahwebservice.com/b2b-lead-generation): AI-powered lead generation building targeted prospect databases with verified decision-makers and CRM-ready contact information for outbound campaigns.
- [Prospect List Building](https://www.islahwebservice.com/prospect-list-building): Researched, filtered, and qualified prospect databases built around your ideal customer profile.
- [Contact Enrichment](https://www.islahwebservice.com/contact-enrichment): Complete prospect records with verified emails, LinkedIn profiles, job titles, and company data.
- [Decision Maker Research & Contact Discovery](https://www.islahwebservice.com/decision-maker-research): Identify the operations managers, IT directors, sales directors, owners, and marketing managers who actually buy.

## Industries
- [Managed Service Providers](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/msp): Verified prospect lists for businesses that need managed IT, security, and support.
- [SaaS Companies](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/saas): ICP-qualified prospect lists for software and platform teams.
- [Recruitment Firms](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/recruitment): Verified company and hiring-decision-maker data for recruiters.
- [Professional Services](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/professional-services): Targeted prospect databases for consultancies and agencies.
